description: This file defines the ViewsConfigUpdater class in Drupal, providing methods to update and migrate view configurations, handle deprecations, and ensure compatibility across Drupal versions.

classes.name: Drupal\views\ViewsConfigUpdater
classes.description: A class providing a backward compatibility layer for updating view configurations and handling deprecated settings in Drupal.

methods.name: updateAll
methods.description: Performs all necessary updates on a given view entity.

methods.name: processDisplayHandlers
methods.description: Processes display handlers for a view, applying a callback to update handlers.

methods.name: needsEntityArgumentUpdate
methods.description: Checks if entity arguments need updating from 'numeric' to 'entity_target_id'.

methods.name: processEntityArgumentUpdate
methods.description: Converts 'numeric' plugin_id arguments to 'entity_target_id' where applicable.

methods.name: needsFormatPluralUpdate
methods.description: Checks if fields with 'format_plural' option need updating.

methods.name: processFieldHandlerWithFormatPlural
methods.description: Updates 'format_plural' option to boolean for fields.

methods.name: needsRememberRolesUpdate
methods.description: Checks if 'remember_roles' setting in filters has disabled roles.

methods.name: processRememberRolesUpdate
methods.description: Removes disabled roles from 'remember_roles' in filters.

methods.name: needsTableCssClassUpdate
methods.description: Checks if views need default CSS class for table style.

methods.name: processTableCssClassUpdate
methods.description: Adds default CSS class to table style views if missing.

methods.name: needsBlockContentListingEmptyUpdate
methods.description: Checks if 'block_content_listing_empty' plugin should be removed.

methods.name: needsRssViewModeUpdate
methods.description: Checks if views need default RSS view mode.

methods.name: processRssViewModeUpdate
methods.description: Sets default RSS view mode for views if necessary.
